import 'package:async/async.dart';

final word = RegExp(r'\w+');
// Don't SELECT * FROM users here.
/* Don't SELECT * FROM users
   or read jsonb here either. */

bool words(String text, int size, String pattern) {
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-dart
  final found = RegExp(r'a+b');
  final dynamic = RegExp(pattern);
  // ruleid: whole-row-sql-dart
  final query = 'SELECT * FROM users';
  final exists = 'SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)';
  final copy = 'INSERT INTO archive SELECT * FROM users';
  // ruleid: json-column-dart
  final key = "SELECT data->>'k' FROM users";
  // ruleid: bool-array-dart
  final seen = List<bool>.filled(size, false);
  // ruleid: in-process-cache-dart
  final cache = AsyncCache<int>(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  return query.isEmpty && copy.isEmpty && key.isEmpty && exists.isEmpty && found.hasMatch(text) && dynamic.hasMatch(text) && seen.isEmpty && cache.hashCode > 0;
}

Future<void> load(List<String> ids, Client client, Client users, Client blocks, Client orders, Stream<String> lines, Object context) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.get(id);
  }
  var cursor = await client.page('');
  while (cursor.isNotEmpty) {
    cursor = await client.page(cursor);
  }
  for (final id in ids) {
    await client.put(id);
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final first = await users.get('a');
  final second = await orders.get('b');
  final third = await client.get(second);
  print(third);
  final yes = await showDialog(context);
  final no = await showDialog(context);
  print(no);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final top = await blocks.get('a');
  final bottom = await blocks.get('b');
  print(no);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final left = await client.get('a');
  final right = await client.get('b');
  await for (final line in lines) {
    await client.put(line);
  }
  await for (final line in client.stream(
    'a',
  )) {
    await client.put(line);
  }
  print([first, third, yes, no, top, bottom, left, right]);
  for (var start = 0; start < ids.length; start += 2) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(ids.skip(start).take(2).map(client.get));
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.put(ids[start]);
  }
  for (var start = 0; start < ids.length; start += 2) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.get(ids[start]);
  }
  for (final id in ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait([client.get(id), users.get(id)]);
  }
  for (final id in ids) {
    if (await client.has(id)) throw StateError(id);
  }
  for (var start = 0; start < ids.length; start += 2) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.wait(ids.skip(start).take(2).map((id) async => MapEntry(
      id,
      await client.get(id),
    )));
  }
  await client.run(() async {
    for (final id in ids) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await client.get(id);
    }
  });
  final rows = <String, Object>{};
  for (final id in ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    rows[id] ??= await client.get(id);
  }
  for (final id in ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    rows[id] = await client.get(id);
  }
  final grouped = await client.all(ids, (id) async {
    final row = await client.get(id);
    final more = await client.get(row);
    return more;
  });
  print(grouped);
  final base = await users.get('a');
  final derived = await client.each(ids, (id) async {
    print(id);
    return client.get(base);
  });
  print(derived);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final step = await client.step(() async {
    await client.put('x');
    return 1;
  });
  final after = await orders.get('c');
  print([step, after]);
}

Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

Future<void> inOrderSteps(List<Future<void> Function()> steps, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final step in steps) {
    await step();
  }
}

Future<void> inOrderWithoutReason<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await step(item);
  }
}

class OtherOrder {
  Future<void> inOrder<T>(Iterable<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step) async {
    for (final item in items) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await step(item);
    }
  }
}

class WrongOrderSignature {
  Future<void> inOrder<T>(List<T> items, Future<void> Function(T item) step, {required String reason}) async {
    for (final item in items) {
      await step(item);
    }
  }

  Future<void> inOrderSteps(List<Future<void> Function()> steps, {String reason = ''}) async {
    for (final step in steps) {
      await step();
    }
  }
}

Future<void> reviewedOrder(items, client, orders, String reason) async {
  await inOrder(items, (item) async {
    // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
    final first = await client.get(item);
    final second = await orders.get(item);
    print([first, second]);
    for (final child in item.children) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await client.get(child);
    }
  }, reason: 'Each update reads the previous write');
  await inOrderSteps([
    () async {
      // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
      final first = await client.get('a');
      final second = await orders.get('b');
      print([first, second]);
    },
  ], reason: 'Each stage needs the preceding stage');
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrder(items, client.put, reason: reason);
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrder(items, client.put);
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([]);
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrder(items, client.put, reason: '');
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: 'too short');
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrder(items, client.put, reason: 'singlewordlongerthantwentycharacters');
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: '                       ');
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: '1234567890 123456789');
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: "Each stage needs the preceding stage");
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: "Each writer's result feeds the next");
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: '123456789 123456789');
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: 'The order is $reason');
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: 12345678901234567890);
  // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-dart
  await inOrderSteps([], reason: 'singlewordlongerthantwentycharacters   ');
}

Future<void> carriedResult(items, client, orders) async {
  var cursor = 'start';
  for (final item in items) {
    cursor = await client.next(item, cursor);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await orders.notify(item);
  }
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    cursor = await client.next(item);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await orders.put(cursor);
  }
}

Future<void> stoppingPoll(items, client, done, pause, wait) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(item);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.any([done.future, pause(wait)]);
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(i);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.any([done.future, pause(wait)]);
  }
  while (client.active) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.any([done.future, pause(wait)]);
  }
  for (final item in items) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll(item);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.any([client.ready(), pause(wait)]);
  }
  while (client.active) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.poll();
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await Future.any([done.future, pause(wait)]);
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.write();
  }
}
